method: v4_scale_bench.py --check, three ordinary -O2 runs per side, medians per metric

v3_compare_provenance.v3_build: two V3 generations from build/freakc_v3.fk.c (sha256 730fec42445c17c3b243b3880c76be8942eb31ba8666c28b265330a3b5e1016f) with the ci.yml steps, Ubuntu clang 18.1.3
commands: python -B -u benchmarks/v4/v3_compare.py --v3 V3 --v4 V4C --shapes tasks long calls --sizes 200 800 1600 --repeats 3 --timeout 600

v3_compare_provenance.correctness: a cell is reported only when every V3 and V4 run exits 0 with a non-empty module (V4 also v4-errors=0)
